about_the_game: All these years, piece was lying around on all of these fields. But one day, a sudden sad moment happened, since by fire and monsters our people got threatened. Nor heroes, nor luck was on our side, but a fallen knight, who had depression on his mind. He lost his home, he lost his sword, but he gain a new weapon, and now he ain't bored. In your hand, dear player, the future of our life, hope that you will be able to save all the people, husbands, kids and wives. The journey will have a lot to tell, but for now we just offer you a trial to tell. Shoot your way through the enemy lines, heal yourself with potions, like you would drinking nice wines. Modify your gun just like how feel, if you would happen to die quick, dont worry, its not a big deal. We all can learn from our mistakes, I hope though you will do whatever it takes. Save the Kingdom, save our lives, so we can offer you more start than fives.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F CPU @ 2.90GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 with 4GB GDDR5
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek High Definition Audio
  • VR Support: No, not yet.

short_description: You've wondered what happens when a knight loses his home and his sword. Join the Tale of the Bullet Knight trial to get a taste of the game and experience the first steps of our adventure. Shoot, jump, rung and gun, the more you progress, the more it will be FUN.
